claims.claim_text: For every integer N greater than one, big-Witt Verschiebung has no additive sheaf lift through omega on the absolute fppf site.

negative_constraints.rule: Do not describe the result as a ring-operation law or a Route-A quantization obstruction.

claims.claim_text: The same non-liftability holds on the finite-flat site by a separately checked finite-free descent argument.

negative_constraints.rule: Do not infer the finite-flat result solely from the fppf theorem.

claims.claim_text: For the actual extension e and every u on its kernel, u pushout e differs from the V_N pullback of e when N is greater than one.

negative_constraints.rule: Do not claim that Cech cohomology computes the full sheaf Ext group.

claims.claim_text: The finite-flat example shows that the sectionwise Dedekind assertion in Corollary 4.6 of Deninger v1 requires correction.

negative_constraints.rule: Preserve Propositions 4.3 and 4.5 and Example 4.4 as valid independent inputs; use respectful source-sensitive wording.

manifest_negative_constraints.rule: No packet, dynamical, trace, operator, determinant, Route-A, Route-B, or Hilbert-Polya advancement claim.
